fields.label: Background photo
fields.name: bg_image
fields.instructions: Wide photo shown behind the text. Recommended at least 1920px wide.

fields.label: Title
fields.name: title
fields.instructions: Big headline, e.g. “The Story Behind our Handcrafted Pies”. Shown in uppercase automatically.

fields.label: Subhead (script line)
fields.name: subhead
fields.instructions: Short line under the title, shown in the handwritten script font.

fields.label: Button text
fields.name: cta_label
fields.instructions: Leave empty to hide the button.

fields.label: Button link
fields.name: cta_url
fields.instructions: Where the button goes, e.g. /story/ or a full https:// address.

fields.label: Open style (text directly on photo)
fields.name: open_style
fields.instructions: On: light text directly over the photo. Off: text inside a cream box.

fields.label: Breathing room above
fields.name: show_spacer
fields.instructions: Adds a small gap above the banner.
